target.name: T. cruzi GSK-3 Kinase
target.domain_rationale: CMGC-family Ser/Thr kinase closely homologous to human GSK3A/GSK3B represented in the Davis benchmark.
target.disease_burden: 6-7 million people infected worldwide (WHO), causing chronic cardiomyopathy with only two toxic legacy drugs.
target.target_biology: Essential trypanosomatid kinase regulating parasite proliferation and survival; validated NTD drug target.
target.reference_note: Multiple FDA kinase inhibitors have been screened against Trypanosoma cruzi kinases in repurposing literature.
